💡 The novelty lies in transferring lithium battery design heuristics to aqueous electrolytes, revealing that optimal transport rules differ fundamentally from nonaqueous systems. This is significant because it challenges prevailing assumptions, provides new design principles for aqueous batteries, and could accelerate development of safer, lower-cost energy storage.

💡 This study reveals that in mixed-cation Li5₋xNaxLa3Ta2O12 garnets, a 3:1 Li:Na ratio yields optimal ionic conductivity via site-competition-driven synergistic Li+/Na+ transport.
